patches.description: Rewrite the __ModuleLoader__ bundle id from @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace to dsh-workspace-sections-official; this bundle replaces the shipped ui-workspace row, so no slot priority override is needed.

Tag each official derived workspace group with a section (active / history / inactive), pinnedSection and latestActivity, recognise the D:\files\history-tasks workspace, and return the official derivation unchanged in native mode.

Render three fixed section headers (active -> history -> inactive), indent project rows one level in sections mode, flatten history sessions, and persist section-collapse state; native mode renders the official tree unchanged.
Extend the official ViewOptionsMenu with the sections switch, active-days +/- and reset, and add pin entries to the workspace row menu (sections mode only).

Add the plugin-owned section state (mode/threshold/pins/collapse), the History workspace bootstrap, the browser injection wiring and a sidebar.footer.action return button; no official registration is removed.
